actions.desc: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. In addition to being grappled, the engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 CON save at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and 3 (1d6) poison damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

actions.desc: The shambling mound makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +7 к попаданию, досягаемость 5 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 13 (2к8+4) дробящего урона плюс 7 (2к6) ядовитого урона.
actions.name: Slam

traits.desc: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains HP equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.desc: The shambling mound is resistant to exhaustion and to the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.

traits.desc: The shambling mound emits the smell of rotting vegetation. A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the shambling mound must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.
